title: Management of revenues
locator: Paragraph on annual transfers; paragraph beginning Petroleum revenues are phased
supports: Petroleum receipts enter the fund; budget use follows an over-time expected-return guideline allowing cyclical adjustment.
doesNotEstablish: A hard annual spending ceiling, exact current fiscal room, or the cost of a proposed policy.

title: Klimagassregnskap for kommuner og fylker
locator: Opening paragraphs on geographic boundaries and indirect emissions
supports: Municipal inventories are geographically bounded and exclude indirect emissions from consumed goods and services.
doesNotEstablish: The accounting rules for every national or international climate target, or any project's global emissions effect.

title: Nett
locator: Kraftnettet er bygget opp på følgende måte
supports: Transmission, regional and distribution networks connect generation with consumers.
doesNotEstablish: Available capacity, queue priority, connection rights or construction dates for a particular project.

title: Kraftproduksjon
locator: Table: Installert effekt MW / Midlere årsproduksjon TWh
supports: Installed power and annual energy production are separate measures; forecasts are assumption-dependent.
doesNotEstablish: Hourly adequacy, local grid capacity, future prices or firm output of a specific project.

title: Utslipp til luft
locator: Utslipp av klimagasser: paragraphs on gas turbines and power from shore
supports: Power from shore replaces an important source of operational petroleum emissions.
doesNotEstablish: Net global climate benefit or full lifecycle cost for an individual electrification project.

title: Inntektssystemet for kommuner og fylkeskommuner
supports: Unrestricted municipal income includes tax revenue and block grants, subject to applicable laws.
doesNotEstablish: A particular municipality's fiscal capacity or the cost of changing a service standard.
